query: Plan a trip focused only on ancient temples.
answer:
Here's a focused 5-day itinerary showcasing Egypt's ancient temples! This trip will immerse you in the rich history and stunning architecture of these sacred sites. 🌟

---

**Day 1 — Arrival in Cairo & Giza**

Morning
• Arrive at Cairo International Airport and transfer to your hotel — check-in and freshen up.

Lunch
• Local restaurant — enjoy traditional Egyptian dishes.

Afternoon
• **Tomb of Queen Hetepheres I** — 1-2 hours — Explore the sealed shaft tomb of Khufu's mother, which contains a remarkably intact set of royal funerary furniture. Visit early to avoid crowds!  
  - **Ticket Price:** 100 EGP  
  - **Best Visit Time:** Mid-morning

![Tomb of Queen Hetepheres I](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/tomb-of-queen-hetepheres-i-1-1781570396.jpg)

Evening
• Dinner at a restaurant with Nile views — relax and enjoy the atmosphere.

---

**Day 2 — Luxor**

Morning
• **El-Kab (Nekheb)** — 2-3 hours — Visit this ancient walled city featuring rock-cut tombs and temple remains, offering a glimpse into the spiritual and physical lives of its ancient inhabitants.  
  - **Ticket Price:** 80 EGP  
  - **Best Visit Time:** Mid-morning

![El-Kab (Nekheb)](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/el-kab-nekheb-0.jpg)

Lunch
• Local restaurant in Luxor — try popular local dishes.

Afternoon
• **Karnak Temple** — 3 hours — Explore the vast temple complex, one of the largest religious sites in the world, featuring impressive columns and ancient hieroglyphs.

Evening
• Dinner at a local eatery with traditional music.

---

**Day 3 — Aswan**

Morning
• Travel to Aswan (consider a morning flight or train) — check into your hotel.

Lunch
• Local restaurant in Aswan — savor Nubian cuisine.

Afternoon
• **Temple of Dakka** — 1-2 hours — Visit this Greco-Roman temple dedicated to Thoth, which was relocated near Wadi es-Sebua.  
  - **Ticket Price:** 100 EGP  
  - **Best Visit Time:** Morning (consider a boat trip on Lake Nasser)

![Temple of Dakka](***REMOVED***/storage/v1/object/public/poi-images/pois/temple-of-dakka-0.jpg)

Evening
• Dinner on a felucca (traditional sailboat) — enjoy the sunset on the Nile.

---

**Day 4 — Abu Simbel**

Morning
• **Abu Simbel Temples** — 3 hours — Take a guided tour to explore these magnificent temples of Ramses II, carved from the mountainside. An early start is recommended!  

Lunch
• Packed lunch or local restaurant near Abu Simbel.

Afternoon
• Return to Aswan — relax at your hotel or enjoy a Nile-side café.

Evening
• Optional visit to the Nubian Museum — learn about Aswan's rich heritage.

---

**Day 5 — Departure**

Morning
• Transfer back to Cairo — check into your hotel if time allows.

Lunch
• Local restaurant — enjoy some grilled meats and salads.

Afternoon
• Free time for last-minute shopping or revisiting favorite sites.

Evening
• Departure from Cairo International Airport.

---

**Travel Tips**
- Make sure to have Egyptian pounds (EGP) for local purchases, as many places accept cash only.
- Wear comfortable shoes for walking around the ancient sites.
- Always carry a bottle of water, especially while sightseeing.
- Check the opening hours of attractions in advance to plan your visits.
